mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payment_return_check SET version=#{version},status=#{status},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},active_marker=#{active} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_return_check WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_return_check WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{paymentId} AND requested_by=#{actor} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_return_check WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{paymentId} AND status IN ('CHECKED','RESOLVED') ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT state_json FROM supplier_payment_return_check_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND check_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM supplier_payment_return_check q LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.payment_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT payment_version,input_json FROM supplier_payment_returns WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND payment_id=#{id}
